title: Generalized Residual Closure: General Learning Dynamics for Stability-Plasticity Compatibility
abstract: arXiv:2609.38911v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learning must acquire new capabilities while preserving both prior responsibilities and the capacity to learn again. We introduce Generalized Residual Closure (GRC), a framework for learning as recursive closure of future-relevant discrepancies: closing a residual establishes the conditions for subsequent prediction, interaction, and learning. Under a complete representation-relation description at a fixed learner-world boundary, persistent internal learning has two primitive modes: Transformation within a representation and revision of the Representation itself. We establish a local tangent decomposition under regularity assumptions and a criterion for when representation revision is necessary. In an affine model, we derive a necessary-and-sufficient condition for stability-plasticity compatibility and the unique solution of a constrained quadratic update problem, which preserves registered old responsibilities while reducing residuals

translated_title: 广义残差闭合：面向稳定性-可塑性兼容的一般学习动力学
translated_abstract: 学习必须能够在获取新能力的同时，保持既有的职责以及再次学习的能力。我们提出了广义残差闭合（GRC），这是一个将学习视为对未来相关差异进行递归闭合的框架：闭合一个残差会为后续的预测、交互和学习建立条件。在固定的学习者-世界边界上具有完备的表示-关系描述的前提下，持续的内在学习存在两种基本模式：表示内部的变换，以及表示本身的修订。我们在正则性假设下建立了局部切空间分解，并给出了判断何时必须进行表示修订的判据。在仿射模型中，我们推导出了稳定性-可塑性兼容的充要条件，以及一个约束二次更新问题的唯一解，该解能够在保留已登记旧职责的同时减少残差。
tldr: 提出广义残差闭合（GRC）框架，将学习建模为对未来相关差异的递归闭合，并推导出稳定性-可塑性兼容的充要条件，以及在保留旧职责的同时减少残差的唯一最优更新解。
en_tdlr: Proposes Generalized Residual Closure (GRC), a framework that models learning as the recursive closure of future-relevant discrepancies, deriving a necessary-and-sufficient condition for stability-plasticity compatibility and the unique optimal update solution that preserves old responsibilities while reducing residuals.
